item.title: RECAP: North Wales braced for snow and ice as weather warnings continue
item.description: North Wales is braced for snow and ice as the yellow weather warnings for snow and ice continue today (Saturday). The Met Office's current warning is ending at 10am, but will be replaced by a further warning which begins at 3pm tomorrow (Sunday) and lasts until midday on Monday.

item.title: Why the £7.99 Aldi heated car seat cover is my best-ever middle aisle buy

item.title: 'Do not eat': Waitrose, Tesco, Poundland, Lidl & more UK supermarkets issue recalls

item.title: Victorian house with annex 'perfect for independent family members'
item.description: A six-bedroom, semi-detached Victorian house with a separate self-contained annex is now on the market in Craig-y-Don, Llandudno for £435,000.

item.title: Recap: Road closures as snow and ice hits North Wales
item.description: Road closures have hit the North Wales region as the area braces itself for another day of snow and ice. The Met Office currently has live yellow weather warnings for snow and ice, with a further one due to begin at 3pm today (Sunday).
